name: Cyprus

flag.description: A white field with a copper-orange silhouette of the island in the centre, above two crossed green olive branches.
flag.symbolism: The copper colour refers to the island's rich copper deposits, from which its name is often derived; the olive branches and white field stand for peace between Greek and Turkish Cypriots.

hook: A copper map of the island floating over olive branches on white: Cyprus shows its own outline, like Kosovo, but on white instead of blue.
trivia: Cyprus and Kosovo are the only countries whose national flags show a map of the country.
The colours were deliberately chosen to avoid the blue of Greece and the red of Turkey.
